Pose the mechanism

0° Both drive motors push against the yoke; their sum swings it and gravity rolls the robot. Nothing blocks it: it can swing a full 360°.
0° A worm drive slides the 15.6 kg tungsten + 936 Wh battery bob along a ±40° arc to counter-lean in fast turns. Steering itself comes from the left/right torque difference.
0° Near 0°: pure roll torque (wobble damping). Parked at ±90° and swept together: pure yaw torque (turn in place).
0% Tyre halves, pods and the bob pull apart along their assembly directions.

Bodies

Tyre halves: each driven by its own motor Spine: axle, pods, bays, kept level Yoke: pendulum pitch body, drive train Bob: battery + tungsten, lateral lean
